Our Home Base

Greater Grand Rapids
Metro Area

Northline is based on Leonard Street NW in Grand Rapids — right in the middle of the metro area. Our central location means we can reach most of our service area within 30–45 minutes under normal conditions.

For after-hours emergencies, we have technicians staged in different parts of the metro to minimize drive time. If you’re not sure we cover your address, call and ask — we’re flexible for established customers and willing to discuss coverage for first-time callers outside our normal boundary.

Key Communities

Serving These Communities
Every Day

Grand Rapids

Our home base. We know every neighborhood from Heritage Hill's older homes to the newer construction on the south end. Fastest response times in the city, including East Hills, Eastown, and Creston.

Kentwood

We do heavy volume in Kentwood, especially water heater work and drain cleaning in the area's ranch homes. Most service calls are handled same day.

Ada & Cascade

Active in both communities for boiler service and larger custom home projects. We understand the specific plumbing challenges in Ada's older farmhouses and Cascade's newer developments.

Walker

Strong customer base in Walker, particularly for sewer line work and bathroom additions. Walker's mix of 1960s homes and newer subdivisions keeps our team busy year-round.

Grandville & Jenison

Serving these communities for over 30 years. Common work includes aging cast iron drain replacement, tankless water heater upgrades, and emergency repairs in the area's growing neighborhoods.

Rockford & Belmont

Our northernmost regular service communities. We handle both municipal water and well systems in this area. Rockford and Belmont customers receive full emergency coverage.
